purpose: development mechanism-identifiability gate; not formal paper evidence

controls.capacity: All arms instantiate the same PBRC network including the plan head.
controls.plain: Uses the individual role-intent head at all policy-active steps.
controls.plan_no_reliability: Uses the team plan head with public reliability replaced by 0.5.
controls.permuted_pbrc: Uses the team plan head with 0.1 and 0.9 public reliability semantics exchanged.
controls.pbrc: Uses the team plan head with the correct public reliability value.

boundary: The gate tests whether the specified mechanism changes pre-arrival public-plan behavior without global task collapse. It does not establish method superiority, causality, generalization, or publication readiness.
